import pandas as pd

departures = departures.reindex(all_boroughs, fill_value=0)
arrivals = arrivals.reindex(all_boroughs, fill_value=0)

print('SCI values:')

    print(f'  {b}: {sci[b]:.6f}')

# Build adjacency matrix for these boroughs
# Use directed list as symmetric binary weights
borough_index = {b: i for i, b in enumerate(all_boroughs)}
n = len(all_boroughs)
W = np.zeros((n, n), dtype=float)

for _, row in adj.iterrows():

    neigh = row['neighbor']

# Compute Moran's I

z = x - x_mean

denominator = np.sum(z ** 2)
W_sum = np.sum(W)

moran_I = (n / W_sum) * (numerator / denominator)

# Permutation test: 1000 shuffles

    num_perm = np.sum(W * np.outer(z_perm, z_perm))
    perm_I[k] = (n / W_sum) * (num_perm / denominator)

p_value = np.mean(perm_I >= moran_I)
print('Permutation p-value (one-sided):', p_value)
print('Mean permuted I:', np.mean(perm_I))
print('Std permuted I:', np.std(perm_I))
print('Min permuted I:', np.min(perm_I))
print('Max permuted I:', np.max(perm_I))
